data.one_liner: A simple image slideshow widget for Flutter with autoplay and loop support.
data.what_it_does: Provides an ImageSlideshow widget that displays a list of child widgets (typically images) with page indicators. Supports features like autoplay intervals, looping, manual scroll disabling, and custom indicators.
use_when: You need a basic image carousel or banner slider with minimal setup
You require auto-scrolling slideshows with customizable page indicators
avoid_when: You need complex transitions or highly customized gallery viewports
You require full-featured photo viewing with pinch-to-zoom capabilities
strengths: Easy to set up and use
weaknesses: Lacks advanced interactive gestures like pinch-to-zoom

alternatives.name: photo_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose photo_view if you need advanced image zooming, panning, and detailed gallery views.

data.minimal_example:
ImageSlideshow(
  width: double.infinity,
  height: 200,
  initialPage: 0,
  indicatorColor: Colors.blue,
  indicatorBackgroundColor: Colors.grey,
  children: [
    Image.asset('images/sample_image_1.jpg', fit: BoxFit.cover),
    Image.asset('images/sample_image_2.jpg', fit: BoxFit.cover),
  ],
  autoPlayInterval: 3000,
  isLoop: true,
)
